name: year
description: Ano inicial do exercício fiscal australiano a que se referem os dados; 2004 corresponde ao exercício 2004-05, encerrado em 30 de junho de 2005
description_en: Start year of the Australian financial year the data refer to; 2004 denotes the 2004-05 year, ending 30 June 2005
description_es: Año inicial del ejercicio fiscal australiano al que se refieren los datos; 2004 corresponde al ejercicio 2004-05, cerrado el 30 de junio de 2005

name: state_id
description: Código do estado ou território australiano de residência
observations: ASGS state and territory code (1 New South Wales to 8 Australian Capital Territory). The national aggregate lives in the companion _australia table, because ABS rounds every value to the nearest 10 and the states therefore do not sum to the published Australia figure
description_en: Code of the Australian state or territory of residence
description_es: Código del estado o territorio australiano de residencia

name: age_group
description: Código do grupo etário do migrante
observations: ABS five-year age groups; TOT is all ages. Beware the code A59, which denotes 5-9 years, not 59. The interstate series carries finer groups at the top of the distribution
description_en: Code of the migrant's age group
description_es: Código del grupo de edad del migrante

name: arrivals
description: Número de chegadas de migrantes de outros estados ou territórios
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de llegadas de migrantes de otros estados o territorios

name: departures
description: Número de partidas de migrantes para outros estados ou territórios
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de salidas de migrantes hacia otros estados o territorios

name: net
description: Migração líquida interestadual: chegadas menos partidas
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals. Can be negative
description_en: Net interstate migration: arrivals minus departures
description_es: Migración neta interestatal: llegadas menos salidas
